run_evaluate_boxes: run evaluate_boxes to evaluate detection results on a PASCAL VOC dataset and compute mean AP
run_voc_info: run voc_info to extract year, image set, and devkit paths from a VOC dataset object
run_write_voc_results_files: run _write_voc_results_files to write detection results in VOC format text files for each class
run_do_python_eval: run _do_python_eval to compute AP metrics using the unofficial Python evaluation code for a VOC dataset
run_do_matlab_eval: run _do_matlab_eval to compute results using the official MATLAB evaluation code for a VOC dataset
